data.body:
LANDED. Gerrit change 2327 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2327) merged to main with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 (CI green across ubuntu py3.11/3.12/3.13).

Fix (test-only, behavior-preserving): tier-wide autouse fixture _isolated_mcp_client_home in tests/unit/conftest.py redirects doctor_mcp_client.scan_mcp_clients's default home (the home=None CLI path) to an empty per-session dir, so every doctor_cli-driven unit test sees an unconfigured home and never reads the operator's real ~/.codex/~/.copilot/~/.claude configs. $HOME is left untouched (git identity, ~/.aws and other home-derived resources other unit tests legitimately rely on are unaffected) — mirrors the existing _no_real_session_log_writes seam neutralization. Production doctor still reads the real home.

Held-out oracle test_doctor_cli_mcp_client_scan_is_hermetic (test_doctor_mapping.py) asserts every MCP-client finding path resolves under the injected isolation dir (never Path.home()); RED against pre-fix code, GREEN with the fixture. Mutation-checked: disabling only the seam patch returns it to RED.

Validation: full unit tier 14137 passed / 0 failed locally; CI Verified +1. make lint + make typecheck clean.

Attribution: caused_by 71e7-4626-cb19-42d7 (change 2272 introduced the HOME scan), class plan_defect.

Step-7 sibling: filed 864e-0fe2-820a-41ac (unhelpful-quartzitic-cardinal), discovered_from this ticket — a SEPARATE latent non-hermeticity where LLM/AWS provider unit tests (test_provider_parity et al.) read the operator's real ~/.aws; runtime-confirmed 6 failures under empty HOME. Deliberately out of scope here (needs a different seam).
